title: Fora do Servidor
locations: Kairos Recreation Center, Los Angeles, California
summary: Kairos opens its Recreation Center and Arthur Fletcher is confirmed to be living in an accessible campus residence during cancer treatment in Los Angeles.
keyEvents: The Kairos Recreation Center opens with an indoor multi-sport court, basketball, futsal, volleyball, two table-tennis tables, and a mobility area connected to the existing gym.
Players use the facility on a free day, not in a public competition.
Arthur Fletcher is living in an accessible campus-area residence while treatment continues in Los Angeles.
Arthur remains Owen Fletcher's grandfather, not a Kairos employee or decision-maker.
